What MileWage needs to record a shift with the screen off.

MileWage records your location, including when the app is closed or the screen is off, from when you start a shift until you end it. It uses your location only to count your miles and sends it to your own server.
The steps left are recommended; they keep recording reliable with the screen off.
It needs precise location and the phone\'s Location switch on. Both are below.
The phone\'s Location must be on, or no miles are recorded.
Counts your miles while a shift runs. Choose Precise and While using the app.
Lets recording start again by itself if the phone stops it, for example after a restart. A shift you start in the app records with the screen off without it.
Android opens MileWage\'s location settings. Choose %1$s there, then come back.
Shows your shift\'s time and distance and the reminders.

Phone makers stop apps in the background to save battery, and a stopped app records nothing. Let MileWage run without battery limits: in the list that opens, find MileWage and choose not to optimise it.
On this phone also: Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, then add MileWage to Never sleeping apps.
Some phones also stop apps to save power. dontkillmyapp.com lists the steps for each make.
Lets MileWage reach your server on your home Wi-Fi and send to it there.
Not allowed. Change it in the app\'s settings.
Anything you skip stays on Home\'s checklist.
